items.title: Stripes Beauty expands to 448 Ulta stores as menopause care moves into the mainstream
items.summary: Six months after entering four Ulta Beauty stores, Stripes Beauty is expanding into 448 locations, marking a major push into mainstream retail for menopausal skincare.

items.title: Brands won this season of Love Island USA
items.summary: Love Island USA has become a cultural phenomenon. Beauty and fashion brands are leveraging it for ad and influencer campaigns.

items.title: Stripes Beauty (Naomi Watts) expands menopause skincare to 448 Ulta stores
items.summary: Stripes Beauty, co-founded by Naomi Watts, expands from 4 to 448 Ulta Beauty doors. Menopause skincare (moisturizers, serums, body care) is going mainstream. Products target women 40-55+. Brand positions around 'menopause wellness' – a rapidly growing niche in North America skincare.

items.title: Maybelline and CeraVe win big on Love Island USA 2026 – beauty brand integrations drive sales
items.summary: Maybelline and CeraVe featured as official beauty sponsors on Love Island USA Season 7. CeraVe moisturizers and cleansers got heavy screen time, boosting DTC and Amazon sales. Reality TV brand integrations are a key growth channel for mass-market beauty in North America 2026.

items.title: Nadya Okamoto (August/Period brand) joins creator app Pie as CMO – Gen Z beauty creator economy shift
items.summary: Nadya Okamoto, creator of August period care brand, appointed CMO of social app Pie. Signal: Gen Z beauty creators are pivoting from brand ownership to platform building. Influencer-led beauty (period care, clean beauty, inclusive makeup) remains hot in North America. TikTok Shop creator-commerce model is central to discovery.

items.title: North America beauty market 2026: SPF skincare, lip plumpers, and peptide serums dominate Amazon bestsellers
items.summary: Based on aggregated industry reports and news: Amazon beauty bestsellers in North America 2026 consistently feature: EltaMD UV Clear SPF 46 sunscreen (#1 premium SPF), CeraVe Moisturizing Cream (mass-market staple), L'Oreal Revitalift retinol serum, Laneige Lip Sleeping Mask (lip care #1 on TikTok Shop), Mighty Patch pimple patches (acne care trending). Key drivers: skin barrier repair, SPF awareness post-summer, peptide/retinol anti-aging, lip plumping, and clean beauty labeling.
items.company: EltaMD / CeraVe / L'Oréal / Laneige / Hero Cosmetics

items.title: TikTok Shop beauty 2026: Korean skincare, glass skin serums and snail mucin go viral in North America
items.summary: TikTok Shop North America beauty trends 2026: COSRX Snail Mucin 96 Power Essence, Medicube Age-R Booster, Glow Recipe Watermelon Serum, and lip plumping glosses dominate. Korean skincare (K-beauty) routine products see triple-digit YoY growth. Glass skin aesthetic drives multi-step skincare routines. Creators driving purchase via affiliate links.
